verdict.rationale: The evidence says Chroma can be self-hosted (Apache 2.0) and offers a BYOC option for single-tenant deployments, but nothing mentions Kubernetes, an official Helm chart, or an operator. Generic self-hosting and BYOC are adjacent deployment modes, not the specific Kubernetes packaging this story asks for, so the applicable axis is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can deploy to production on Kubernetes with an official Helm chart or operator
